While your VM spins up, we have some entertainment lined up for you! Head over to Bonus Drills to learn how to interact with the <span id="ch1.intro1.2"/> API using the CLI. Everything in <span id="ch1.intro1.2"/> is a <span id="assignment.2.2"/> object, which means you can manage it via the <span id="assignment.2.2"/> API through the underlying RKE2 cluster.
